purpose: 女性美感的半抽象标志候选；保留发型、头颈、身形和姿态线索，省略具体五官

prompts.name: 01 头肩侧影
prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE exceptionally beautiful, tasteful figurative logo symbol for 女性之美, a female appearance reference atlas. The exact design goal is SEMI-ABSTRACT FEMININE BEAUTY: immediately recognizable as a beautiful woman from external appearance cues, yet NO specific face, identity, or character. Beauty must come from exquisitely designed hair silhouette, head tilt, neck and shoulder proportions, graceful balanced curves, and posture. The face is EMPTY NEGATIVE SPACE: absolutely NO interior eyes, eyebrows, pupils, nose drawing, mouth, lips, makeup, or individual facial detail. A delicate outer facial contour is allowed. KEEP the beautiful external appearance cues; do not reduce the figure to a floating oval head, wire human, plain mannequin, or generic bathroom pictogram. Render as a sophisticated artistic emblem made of a few elegantly composed FILLED shapes and generous clean negative spaces, NOT thin continuous-line drawing, NOT ribbon strips, NOT crude geometric cutout, NOT a portrait illustration, NOT a realistic painted woman, NOT anime, NOT chibi. Solid deep dusty-rose silhouette (#92596c), optionally a single restrained champagne accent; flat graphic rendering, precise smooth curves, no gradients, no shaded skin, no 3D, no texture. The figure should feel anonymous and timeless, allowing viewers to imagine many different women. Square canvas, polished and balanced composition, strong readable silhouette. Genuine transparent alpha background, no rectangle or circle backdrop, no borders, no frames, no props, no stars, no flowers, no butterflies, NO lettering, NO watermark, NO numbers, no contact sheet. Genuinely beautiful professional bespoke brand design, avoid generic clipart.

A — expressive head-and-shoulders silhouette. Show one anonymous adult woman's head, long neck and graceful shoulders in a slightly lowered three-quarter side profile, not a literal face drawing. Give her a beautifully shaped crown and softly flowing medium-long hair sweeping behind and around her shoulder in two or three broad organic graphic masses with elegant negative-space channels. Hair should suggest abundant glossy beauty through silhouette alone, with NO individual strand rendering. The blank face's outer forehead-cheek-chin contour is delicately proportioned; the chin, slender neck, collarbone and elegant shoulder line create a serene refined feminine impression. No facial feature inside that blank shape. Incorporate the hair and shoulder shapes into one cohesive substantial mark, with very few separate parts. The visible figure extends to upper torso, no clothing detail, no anatomy detail, tasteful and nonsexual. Do not make a scarf, nun's veil, chess knight, or a featureless bald mannequin. The viewer should think 'an elegant beautiful woman' although they cannot identify any specific facial appearance.
